river_primitives: claim boundary: contract + provider + fixture + comparator + receipt strength + proof debt + certificate boundary

reconciliation.river: RiverKernel generic proof runner / kernel-contract separation
reconciliation.foundry: Execution Kernel + Software Builder deterministic tool authority
reconciliation.disposition: Foundry owns typed capability execution and coding-loop tools; AIOS offers reusable scheduler/grant primitives. RiverKernel remains lineage for proof-runner contract discipline unless an exact archived implementation primitive is recovered that improves these.

reconciliation.river: comparators, proof cases, failure classification, exact rerun
reconciliation.foundry: deterministic evaluation + learning candidates + Software Builder test gates
reconciliation.disposition: Foundry evaluation is internal development feedback. Reuse River comparator/failure-taxonomy discipline where it strengthens tests, but do not call Foundry evaluation an independent certificate.

reconciliation.foundry: promotion gate requires provenance, rights, regression, repeatability and approval; activation is separate and rollbackable
reconciliation.disposition: Foundry promotion decides whether a capability candidate may become active. River-style certificate should be one evidence input/gate for claims that require independent certification, not a replacement for promotion.

reconciliation.river: receipt, trace, certificate are distinct evidence classes
reconciliation.disposition: AIOS receipt = runtime audit event; Workshop receipt = artifact/action record; Foundry receipt = lifecycle evidence; CERT-RIVER certificate = bounded independent claim decision. Do not collapse them into one generic receipt object.

reconciliation.river: PRISM-RIVER routes work through allowed proof/policy paths
reconciliation.disposition: Harness stays global collaboration/governance authority. PRISM patterns can inform per-job proof/use routing without creating a second cross-project router.

reconciliation.river: proof-mode UI must display recorded facts and never imply enforcement/certification
reconciliation.workshop: human cockpit, artifacts, modules, receipts, gated adapters
reconciliation.disposition: Workshop is the natural display surface for certificate/proof state. Import River UI honesty rules; do not embed certification authority in UI code.

reconciliation.river: dirty-key basis required for lawful proof replay
reconciliation.disposition: When Foundry promotes cached proof/reuse, dirty-key inputs should eventually include provider/model, comparator, fixture, expected outputs, proof engine/dependency versions and boundary-affecting code.

explicit_non_authority: does not promote or activate by itself
does not broaden claim beyond proof
